page.layout: One page of text: a verse stanza sequence in the centre, the printed author line right-aligned below it, and at the foot a signature "A 2" at left and the catchword "LOCI" at right. Show-through from the reverse page appears faintly in the right margin and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Nam salus curæ est Domino piorum, Asserit iustos, leuat innocentes, Et laborantes animas potenti Robore firmat.
Eruet iustos quibus impiorum Imminet passim scelerata turba, Et sinet vitam placida per omnem Pace fruantur.

page.notes: The top of the page carries a faint running head or heading that is too washed out to read reliably, so it is omitted. The faint text in the right margin and the faint lines through the centre are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not printed text on this page. The long s in "Asserit" and "iustos" is read from the s ligature in the scan. The verse lines are kept as printed, with the line breaks shown within each stanza paragraph.
